title: Mixins watchers not triggered when watching same property

labels.name: :exclamation: p4-important
labels.description: Priority 4: this fixes bugs that violate documented behavior, or significantly improves perf.

body:
### Version
3.1.1

### Reproduction link
[https://codesandbox.io/s/friendly-burnell-n27xm?file=/src/components/HelloWorld.vue](https://codesandbox.io/s/friendly-burnell-n27xm?file=/src/components/HelloWorld.vue)

[SFC Playground](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#) Clicking the button should display 3 times the change like in 3.0.11

### Steps to reproduce
- Component and mixins to watch the same property (in this case, vue router `$route`)
- Click each of the router link to trigger the watchers

### What is expected?
In 3.0.11, component and all its mixin watchers triggered

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/315831/122254816-15f10a00-cf00-11eb-93a3-4536a6bf25e9.png)


### What is actually happening?
In 3.1.1, only the component watcher got triggered

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/315831/122254760-05d92a80-cf00-11eb-8ab4-2be1ffd82b5a.png)
